description: This file defines the EAPM class, which extends Basic, representing external account/provider configurations for the SuiteCRM system. It manages external API authentication details, user accounts, and related operations within the module.

classes.name: EAPM
classes.description: Represents external account/provider entries linked to users, with methods for managing OAuth tokens, validation, and user-specific account cleanup.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface, currently returning true for 'ACL'.

methods.name: getLoginInfo
methods.description: Retrieves login details for a specified external application, caching results in the session.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Overrides parent to add user ownership restrictions for non-admin users.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the EAPM record, handling password placeholders, clearing relevant cache.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks a record as deleted and clears cache.

methods.name: validated
methods.description: Marks the external account as validated, deactivating duplicates.

methods.name: fillInName
methods.description: Populates the name property based on the application and API details.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional detail fields for display.

methods.name: save_cleanup
methods.description: Clears OAuth tokens and API data post-save.

methods.name: delete_user_accounts
methods.description: Deletes external account entries linked to a specific user.
